title: Summer / Rainy Season Prep
subtitle: Heat, storms, and wet roads — cooling, A/C comfort, wipers, tires, and cabin water checks.

adaptive_rules.coach_note: Hot US summers: tire pressures rise with heat — set cold PSI in the morning, never bleed hot tires to placard.
Wet climates: prioritize tread depth and wipers — hydroplaning risk rises fast under 4/32".
EV summer: precondition while plugged in when possible; cabin thermal load affects range in heat.
